# Environment Config Root (Conference Stage)

Current purpose:
- define environment-facing configuration structure for the conference-stage pipeline
- keep environment naming stable for healthy baseline, teacher, student, and residual stages

Current active scope:
- conference-stage only
- no deployment-first assumptions
- no later-phase A1 expansion by default

Use this directory for:
- environment identity
- task selection naming
- simulator-facing config organization

Deferred by default:
- later-phase hardware-specific environment expansion
- full thesis-wide environment matrix
